title: Velvety Roasted Syrian Rice Pilaf
description: A classic Syrian dish featuring roasted, crisp brown rice with a hint of fermentation, perfect for a low-glycemic meal.
instructions: Rinse the brown rice in a fine-mesh strainer until the water runs clear.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the brown rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the rice vinegar and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover the saucepan and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the rice for 25-30 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve hot, topped with labneh cheese if desired.
